name: devkb
description: Turn coding sessions into a developer knowledge base in Obsidian. Skill: /capture (on demand — save an idea, or sweep the current session for ideas worth keeping, as atomic notes). Also ships a SessionEnd hook that automatically sweeps each finished session for new ideas and drops them into an inbox for later triage. Local-first: reads the vault path from ~/.config/mesh44/config.json; nothing leaves your machine.
